# Sample applications

<!-- Generated by `dart run tool/sample_apps_check.dart --write`; do not edit. -->

Each application in this directory runs and is tested in CI, with the structure of `daravel_starter`. Every package has, or will have, an application that uses it on its own and one that combines it with others (Blueprint #136). `daravel`, `daravel_test`, `daravel_lints` and `dartisan_cli` are in every application.
